# Trump approves firing squad execution for Fort Hood shooter in 60-year first

* [World](/news/topic/world)
* [United States](/news/topic/united-states)

President Donald Trump has approved the execution of the Fort Hood shooter by firing squad - the first execution of this kind in the US since the Second World War.

Nidal Malik Hasan, an Army psychiatrist, killed 13 unarmed US soldiers and injured more than 30 others at Fort Hood, near Killeen, Texas, in 2009.

He walked into a medical building where the soldiers were getting checkups, shouted “Allahu akbar” - Arabic for “God is great!” - and opened fire with a laser-sighted handgun.

The Army secretary will decide a time and place for Hasan'sexecution, Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell wrote in a post on X, adding: "Judgement day for Hasan has finally come".

The US military last carried out the death penalty in 1961.
